 Bali United vs Persik Kediri Final Score 3-0: Irfan Jaya, Yachida, and Queven Make the Difference
 Bali United secured a convincing 3-0 victory over Persik Kediri in the ninth week of the 2026/2027 BRI Super League, with goals from Irfan Jaya, Teppei Yachida, and Queven Inacio.
 By: Damar Prasetya 
 | 
 Editor: Nayla Savitri 
 | 
 Contributor: Niken Pramudya 
 November 8, 2026, 18:29 WITA · 5 min read 
 Photo Caption: Illustration of a duel between Bali United and Persik Kediri players in the 2026/2027 BRI Super League match. Bali United secured a 3-0 victory over Persik Kediri at Kapten I Wayan Dipta Stadium, Gianyar, Sunday (11/8/2026). (Illustration/Aktualita.co) 
 GIANYAR, Aktualita.co -  The final result of Bali United vs Persik Kediri in the ninth week of the 2026/2027 BRI Super League ended in a 3-0 landslide victory for the hosts. Playing at Kapten I Wayan Dipta Stadium, Gianyar, on Sunday (11/8/2026), the Serdadu Tridatu appeared effective in securing three important points in the top-tier standings race. 
 The three goals for Bali United were scored by Irfan Jaya in the sixth minute, Teppei Yachida via a penalty kick in the 33rd minute, and Queven Inacio just before the end of the first half in the 45th minute. 
 Advertisement 
 All of these goals were created before halftime. Persik Kediri , who tried to put up a fight, were unable to narrow the deficit until the match ended. 
 This victory brings Bali United's point tally to 19 from nine matches. Conversely, Persik Kediri must conduct evaluations again after failing to secure points during their visit to the Island of the Gods. 
 The result also serves as revenge for Bali United, who previously lost 2-3 to Persik during the two teams' meeting at Brawijaya Stadium in January 2026. 
 Irfan Jaya Opens Bali United's Lead in the Sixth Minute 
 Bali United immediately showed an attacking approach from the start of the match. Johnny Jansen's team tried to utilize the home-field advantage by pressing the Persik Kediri defense. 
 However, Persik actually had the first opportunity through a corner kick situation in the third minute. 
 That chance did not yield results. Bali United then responded with attacks that forced the visitors' defense to work hard. 
 The deadlock was finally broken when the match had only been running for six minutes. 
 Irfan Jaya successfully utilized a pass from Queven Inacio to unleash a finish that gave Bali United a 1-0 lead. 
 The quick goal changed the situation of the match. Persik, who had previously tried to develop their game, had to increase the intensity of their attacks to find an equalizer. 
 Bali United was not in a hurry after gaining the lead. The hosts continued to look for opportunities while maintaining balance between the lines. 
 Meanwhile, Persik's front line, relying on Sergio Castel and Ernesto Gomez, was unable to produce a reply goal. 
 Teppei Yachida's Penalty Doubles the Lead 
 Entering the middle of the first half, the match became more interesting after Bali United got an opportunity through a situation inside the penalty box. 
 The referee conducted a Video Assistant Referee (VAR) review following an incident involving Zanadin Fariz and Teppei Yachida. 
 After the review, the referee awarded a penalty kick to Bali United. Zanadin also received a yellow card in the sequence of events. 
 Teppei Yachida stepped up as the executor in the 33rd minute. 
 The Japanese midfielder was able to carry out his duty well to change the score to 2-0. 
 The goal further emphasized the effectiveness of Bali United's game, which successfully utilized important momentum throughout the match. 
 For Persik Kediri, the two-goal deficit made their task even heavier. Marcos Reina's team must improve their defensive organization while increasing the quality of their finishing. 
 Persik tried to keep control of the game, but Bali United was more successful in utilizing scoring opportunities. 
 Queven Scores the Third Goal Before Halftime 
 When Persik tried to reduce the pressure, Bali United instead scored again at the end of the first half. 
 Queven Inacio put his name on the scoreboard in the 45th minute after utilizing a pass from Ricky Fajrin Saputra. 
 The goal extended Bali United's lead to 3-0. 
 Queven became one of the most influential players in this match. In addition to scoring the third goal, the player wearing jersey number 88 previously provided the assist for Irfan Jaya's opening goal. 
 The direct contribution to two goals showed Queven's important role in building Bali United's attacks. 
 The three-goal lead meant the hosts entered the dressing room in a very advantageous position. 
 Conversely, Persik had to face a heavy task to turn things around after conceding three times in the first 45 minutes. 
 Second Half of Bali United vs Persik Kediri 
 Entering the second half, Persik Kediri needed at least three goals to equalize. 
 That situation demanded the visitors to increase their attacking courage without ignoring the defense, which had previously been penetrated by Bali United several times. 
 On the other hand, the hosts had the advantage of controlling the rhythm of the game thanks to the three-goal lead. 
 Bali United no longer needed additional goals to ensure victory, but still had to maintain concentration so as not to give Persik a chance to rise. 
 Until the match ended, there were no additional goals that changed the score. 
 The 3-0 score ensured Bali United secured the win while also recording a clean sheet in the home match. 
 Johnny Jansen Had Highlighted the Tight Schedule 
 This victory felt important because Bali United was actually facing the challenge of a tight match schedule. 
 Before hosting Persik, the Serdadu Tridatu played an away match against Arema FC and an I.League Cup match against Persiba Balikpapan. 
 That condition made the team's preparation time relatively limited. 
 "Our preparation was very short," said Bali United coach, Johnny Jansen, in his statement ahead of the match, Saturday (11/7/2026). 
 Nevertheless, Bali United was able to show attacking sharpness when facing Persik. 
 Irfan Jaya's quick goal, Yachida's success in executing the penalty, and Queven's contribution were a reflection of the hosts' ability to utilize important opportunities. 
 Bali United and Persik Kediri Standings After the Match 
 The additional three points bring Bali United to 19 points from nine matches in the 2026/2027 BRI Super League. 
 Before the match, Bali United was in fourth place with 16 points from eight matches. 
 The victory over Persik strengthens the Serdadu Tridatu's chances to continue competing with the top-tier teams. The final position in the standings remains dependent on the results of other clubs' matches. 
 Meanwhile, Persik Kediri is stuck with 10 points after playing nine matches. 
 This defeat is homework for Marcos Reina, especially regarding defensive line coordination and the team's ability to anticipate opponent pressure. 
 Previously, Persik also suffered defeats to Persija Jakarta and Persita Tangerang in the league competition. 
 The result in Gianyar extends that losing streak while also showing that Persik still needs improvements to return to getting positive results. 
 For Bali United, the 3-0 victory is a valuable asset to maintain positive momentum. 
 The Serdadu Tridatu now have the opportunity to continue the top-tier race, while Persik must immediately find solutions before the next match. 
 Final result: Bali United 3-0 Persik Kediri. 
 Goal scorers: Irfan Jaya (6'), Teppei Yachida (33', penalty), Queven Inacio (45').
